paragraphs: Fresh-background retention passes; the brightness robustness and five-point retention gates fail. Each trained policy passes all six neutral cells and none of its twelve shifted cells. All checkpoints stayed fixed. These outcomes measure the previously trained models under new input conditions; they do not demonstrate a new repair.

With neutral inputs, joint continuation has 100% factual and image accuracy in ordinary and reset queries at every declared seed. Image-only continuation has ordinary facts 96.094–100% and images 98.438–100%; reset facts 95.313–100% and images 96.875–100%. The unchanged source controls pass only three of their six neutral full-task cells. Thus the preceding continuation benefit survives these fresh background samples, within this familiar synthetic task.

Offsets of −16 or +16 in observed 8-bit RGB values cause large errors despite unchanged canonical targets, preserved color labels and no clipping. Across trained checkpoints and stress cells, ordinary factual accuracy is 31.250–65.625% and image accuracy 31.250–57.031%; reset facts are 35.156–61.719% and images 35.156–57.812%. Color, shape and position errors all occur. Joint continuation does better than image-only on the positive shift, but neither approach passes either stress conjunction. These ranges describe the declared cells; they are not estimates across independent models.

The frozen direct reader drops from 100% on neutral inputs to 62.5% under the negative shift and 69.531–73.438% under the positive shift. Because factual answers also deteriorate, the evidence does not support treating this as only an image reconstruction problem. The direct reader includes a learned head: its failure does not prove that the encoder discarded the needed information. Representation sensitivity, downstream readout sensitivity and their interaction remain possible.

Local validation passes 67 relevant tests and independently reproduces 12,798 metric values and all 54 full-task gates. All 36 trained-model GPU replays reproduce saved outputs exactly. Input provenance, immutable sources, matched image-only factual outputs and sampled bank/workspace invariants pass. CPU replay fails the declared 1e-4 numerical tolerance in all 36 cells, with maximum native-logit difference 0.481621 and pixel difference 0.014087. Native categories differ in 15 cells, all stressed: four ordinary factual, eight ordinary image, seven reset factual and seven reset image example/query/checkpoint comparisons. Those counts can overlap and are not distinct-world counts. CPU/GPU portability remains unresolved; original results are preserved.

The next proposed repair is a separately predeclared training comparison using input brightness augmentation, with a normalization diagnostic to test which part needs adaptation. Include neutral-data retention and fresh held-out perturbations, and first establish whether frozen features support a better reader before deciding to retrain the encoder. The tested stress populations are now diagnostic data and must not be reused as untouched confirmation. No augmentation training or normalization change was made in this fixed-checkpoint comparison.
